title: ZenML Helm Chart Values
description: Values schema for the ZenML Helm chart (v0.93.2). ZenML: MLOps for Reliable AI: from Classical AI to Agents.

imagePullSecrets.description: List of Docker registry secret names for pulling images from private registries.

name.description: Name of the Kubernetes secret containing Docker registry credentials.

nameOverride.description: Override the name of the chart. Used to customize the resource names generated by the chart.

fullnameOverride.description: Override the full name of the chart. Completely replaces the generated resource names.

replicaCount.description: Number of ZenML server pod replicas to deploy.

threadPoolSize.description: The number of ZenML server worker threads to use. Controls the number of concurrent requests each pod/replica can handle. Should be coordinated with zenml.database.poolSize and zenml.database.maxOverflow (their sum should be >= threadPoolSize).

authThreadPoolSize.description: The number of ZenML server threads dedicated to authentication. Controls concurrent authentication request verification. Should be coordinated with zenml.database.poolSize and zenml.database.maxOverflow (their sum should be >= threadPoolSize + authThreadPoolSize).

requestTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds after which a request is considered timed out. The server returns HTTP 429 (rate limit exceeded) after this period to free up connections. Should be lower than the client's HTTP timeout (default 30s) to avoid client-side timeouts.

requestDeduplication.description: Whether to cache request responses and use them to deduplicate retried requests. Only POST requests and endpoints with longer processing times are cached. Crucial for ensuring idempotency of POST requests. Do not disable unless you know what you are doing.

requestCacheTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds after which a cached request result is deleted.

jwtSecretKey.description: LEGACY shorthand for zenml.auth.jwtSecretKey. The secret key used to sign JWT tokens. If set, takes precedence over zenml.auth.jwtSecretKey in server-secret.yaml. Prefer using zenml.auth.jwtSecretKey instead.

authType.description: LEGACY shorthand for zenml.auth.authType. The ZenML authentication scheme. If set, takes precedence over zenml.auth.authType in _environment.tpl. Prefer using zenml.auth.authType instead.

repository.description: Docker image repository for the ZenML server.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy for the ZenML server container.

tag.description: Overrides the image tag whose default is the chart appVersion.

pro.description: ZenML Pro related options. When enabled, some configuration options in the zenml section will be overridden with values specific to ZenML Pro servers.

enabled.description: Set to true to enable ZenML Pro servers. When enabled, some zenml section values are overridden with ZenML Pro-specific values.

apiURL.description: The URL where the ZenML Pro server API is reachable.

dashboardURL.description: The URL where the ZenML Pro dashboard is reachable.

extraCorsOrigins.description: Additional origins to allow in the CORS policy.

workspaceID.description: The ID of the ZenML Pro workspace to use.

workspaceName.description: The name of the ZenML Pro workspace to use.

organizationID.description: The ID of the ZenML Pro organization to use.

organizationName.description: The name of the ZenML Pro organization to use.

enrollmentKey.description: The enrollment key to use for the ZenML Pro workspace. If not specified, an enrollment key will be auto-generated.

serverURL.description: The URL where the ZenML server API is reachable. If not specified, clients will use the same URL used to connect to the ZenML server. IMPORTANT: this value must be set for ZenML Pro servers.

dashboardURL.description: The URL where the ZenML dashboard is reachable. If not specified, the serverURL value is used. Should be configured if the dashboard is served from a different URL than the ZenML server. Used for web login authentication workflow, dashboard URLs in pipeline logs, etc. Overridden if zenml.pro.enabled is set.

debug.description: Enable or disable debug mode for the ZenML server.

analyticsOptIn.description: Flag to enable/disable the tracking process of the analytics.

deploymentType.description: ZenML server deployment type used for telemetry purposes. Example values: 'local', 'kubernetes', 'aws', 'gcp', 'azure'. Overridden if zenml.pro.enabled is set.

auth.description: Authentication settings that control how the ZenML server authenticates its users.

authType.description: The ZenML authentication scheme. Overridden if zenml.pro.enabled is set.

jwtSecretKey.description: The secret key used to sign JWT tokens. Should be a random string with at least 32 characters. Generate with: `openssl rand -hex 32`. If not set, a random key is generated at install time and reused for upgrades.

jwtTokenAlgorithm.description: The JWT token signing algorithm to use.

jwtTokenIssuer.description: The issuer of the JWT tokens. If not specified, the issuer is set to the ZenML Server ID.

jwtTokenAudience.description: The audience of the JWT tokens. If not specified, the audience is set to the ZenML Server ID.

jwtTokenLeewaySeconds.description: The leeway in seconds allowed when verifying the expiration time of JWT tokens.

jwtTokenExpireMinutes.description: The expiration time of JWT tokens in minutes. If not specified, generated JWT tokens will not expire. Automatically set if zenml.pro.enabled is set.

authCookieName.description: The name of the http-only cookie used to store JWT tokens for web client authentication. If not specified, the cookie name is computed from the ZenML server ID.

authCookieDomain.description: The domain of the http-only cookie used to store JWT tokens for web client authentication. If not specified, the cookie domain is set to the domain of the ZenML server.

corsAllowOrigins.description: Origins allowed to make cross-origin requests to the ZenML server. If not specified, all origins are allowed. Set when the ZenML dashboard is hosted on a different domain. Overridden if zenml.pro.enabled is set.

maxFailedDeviceAuthAttempts.description: Maximum number of failed authentication attempts allowed for an OAuth 2.0 device before the device is locked. Ignored if authType is EXTERNAL or NO_AUTH.

deviceAuthTimeout.description: Timeout in seconds after which a pending OAuth 2.0 device authorization request expires. Ignored if authType is EXTERNAL or NO_AUTH.

deviceAuthPollingInterval.description: Polling interval in seconds used by clients to poll the OAuth 2.0 device authorization endpoint for status of a pending request. Ignored if authType is EXTERNAL or NO_AUTH.

deviceExpirationMinutes.description: Time in minutes that an OAuth 2.0 device is allowed to be used to authenticate with the ZenML server. If not set or jwtTokenExpireMinutes is not set, devices are allowed indefinitely. Controls JWT token expiration for device-authenticated clients. Ignored if authType is EXTERNAL or NO_AUTH.

trustedDeviceExpirationMinutes.description: Time in minutes that a trusted OAuth 2.0 device is allowed to be used to authenticate with the ZenML server. If not set or jwtTokenExpireMinutes is not set, devices are allowed indefinitely. Controls JWT token expiration for trusted device-authenticated clients. Ignored if authType is EXTERNAL or NO_AUTH.

externalLoginURL.description: The login URL of an external authenticator service for the EXTERNAL authentication scheme. Only relevant if authType is EXTERNAL. Overridden if zenml.pro.enabled is set.

externalUserInfoURL.description: The user info URL of an external authenticator service for the EXTERNAL authentication scheme. Only relevant if authType is EXTERNAL. Overridden if zenml.pro.enabled is set.

externalServerID.description: The UUID of the ZenML server for the EXTERNAL authentication scheme. If not specified, the regular ZenML server ID (deployment ID) is used. Overridden if zenml.pro.enabled is set.

rbacImplementationSource.description: Source pointing to a class implementing the RBAC interface (zenml.zen_server.rbac.rbac_interface.RBACInterface). If not specified, RBAC will not be enabled. Overridden if zenml.pro.enabled is set.

featureGateImplementationSource.description: Source pointing to a class implementing the feature gate interface (zenml.zen_server.feature_gate.feature_gate_interface.FeatureGateInterface). If not specified, feature gating will not be enabled. Overridden if zenml.pro.enabled is set.

rootUrlPath.description: The root URL path to use when behind a proxy. Useful when the rewrite-target annotation is used in the ingress controller (e.g., rootUrlPath: /zenml with nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target: /$1).

enableImplicitAuthMethods.description: Enable implicit authentication methods featured by service connectors. Disabled by default for security reasons, as they allow users to authenticate to the cloud provider where ZenML is running without providing credentials.

database.description: MySQL database configuration. If not set, a local SQLite database will be used. To ensure data persistence, configure the persistence section. NOTE: certificate files need to be copied into the helm chart folder with paths relative to the chart root.

persistence.description: Persistence configuration for the local SQLite database. Only relevant when not using an external MySQL database.

enabled.description: If true, the path where the local database is created will be mounted as a persistent volume so data is not lost on pod restarts. Only relevant for local SQLite database.

size.description: Size of the persistent volume claim for the local database.

storageClassName.description: Storage class name for the persistent volume. Empty string uses the default storage class.

url.description: The database URL. If not set, a local SQLite database will be used (not persisted across pod restarts). The URL can contain the password or it can be provided via passwordSecretRef. Example: 'mysql://admin:password@zenml-mysql:3306/database'.

passwordSecretRef.description: Kubernetes secret reference containing the MySQL password. If not set, the password provided in the url option will be used.

name.description: Name of the Kubernetes secret containing the database password.

key.description: Key within the Kubernetes secret that holds the database password.

ssl.description: Set to true to enable SSL for the MySQL database. Setting any of the SSL certificate options (sslCa, sslCert, sslKey) will automatically enable this.

sslCa.description: The MySQL SSL CA certificate. Required for SSL authentication if the CA certificate is not part of the container image. Can be an inline value or a Kubernetes secret reference. NOTE: it is recommended to use zenml.certificates instead for global CA configuration.

secretRef.description: Kubernetes secret reference for the CA certificate.

key.description: Key within the secret containing the certificate.

sslCert.description: The MySQL SSL client certificate. Required for SSL authentication if client certificates are used. Can be an inline value or a Kubernetes secret reference.

secretRef.description: Kubernetes secret reference for the client certificate.

key.description: Key within the secret containing the certificate.

sslKey.description: The MySQL SSL client key. Required for SSL authentication if client certificates are used. Can be an inline value or a Kubernetes secret reference.

secretRef.description: Kubernetes secret reference for the client key.

key.description: Key within the secret containing the private key.

sslVerifyServerCert.description: Set to true to verify the identity of the server against the provided server certificate.

poolSize.description: Database connection pool size (only relevant for MySQL). Should be coordinated with zenml.threadPoolSize so that poolSize + maxOverflow >= threadPoolSize + authThreadPoolSize.

maxOverflow.description: Maximum number of database connections above poolSize that can be created (only relevant for MySQL). Should be coordinated with zenml.threadPoolSize so that poolSize + maxOverflow >= threadPoolSize + authThreadPoolSize.

backupStrategy.description: Database backup strategy before DB migrations. 'disabled' = no backup; 'in-memory' = stored in memory (fastest, not persisted across restarts); 'dump-file' = dumped to local file (optionally on PV); 'database' = copied to backup DB in same server; 'mydumper' = backed up using mydumper/myloader; 'custom' = custom backup engine class.

backupPVStorageClass.description: Storage class for the persistent volume used with 'dump-file' backup strategy.

backupPVStorageSize.description: Size of the persistent volume used with 'dump-file' backup strategy.

backupDatabase.description: Name of the backup database when using the 'database' backup strategy. The database user must have permissions to create, drop, and modify this database.

mydumperThreads.description: Number of threads for mydumper when using the 'mydumper' backup strategy.

mydumperCompress.description: Whether to compress the mydumper dump files.

mydumperExtraArgs.description: Extra arguments to pass to mydumper.

myloaderThreads.description: Number of threads for myloader when restoring with the 'mydumper' backup strategy.

myloaderExtraArgs.description: Extra arguments to pass to myloader.

customBackupEngine.description: Class path of the custom backup engine (e.g., my.custom.backup.engine.MyCustomBackupEngine). The class should extend BaseBackupEngine and be importable from the container image.

customBackupEngineConfig.description: Configuration arguments for the custom backup engine.

secretsStore.description: Secrets store settings for centralized secret management.

enabled.description: Set to false to disable the secrets store.

type.description: The type of secrets store to use. Additional configuration is required under the respective sub-sections depending on the type chosen.

sql.description: SQL secrets store configuration. Only relevant if type is 'sql'.

encryptionKey.description: Secret key used to encrypt secrets in the SQL database. Should be at least 32 random hex characters. Generate with: `openssl rand -hex 32`. If not set, encryption is disabled. IMPORTANT: keep this value safe; losing it means you cannot decrypt existing secrets.

aws.description: AWS Secrets Manager configuration. Only relevant if type is 'aws'. Uses AWS Service Connector authentication methods. See: https://docs.zenml.io/how-to/auth-management/aws-service-connector#authentication-methods

region.description: AWS region where the Secrets Manager service is located. Mandatory for all authentication methods.

aws_access_key_id.description: AWS access key ID. Required for secret-key, sts-token, iam-role, or federation-token auth methods.

aws_secret_access_key.description: AWS secret access key. Required for secret-key, sts-token, iam-role, or federation-token auth methods.

role_arn.description: AWS IAM role ARN. Required for iam-role auth method. Optional for implicit auth method.

region_name.description: DEPRECATED: Use authConfig.region instead. AWS region where the Secrets Manager is located.

aws_access_key_id.description: DEPRECATED: Use authConfig.aws_access_key_id instead. AWS access key ID.

aws_secret_access_key.description: DEPRECATED: Use authConfig.aws_secret_access_key instead. AWS secret access key.

aws_session_token.description: DEPRECATED: AWS session token for temporary credentials.

gcp.description: GCP Secrets Manager configuration. Only relevant if type is 'gcp'. Uses GCP Service Connector authentication methods. See: https://docs.zenml.io/how-to/auth-management/gcp-service-connector#authentication-methods

project_id.description: GCP project ID where the Secrets Manager is located. Mandatory for all authentication methods.

user_account_json.description: GCP user account credentials JSON. Required if authMethod is 'user-account'.

service_account_json.description: GCP service account credentials JSON. Required if authMethod is 'service-account' or 'impersonation'.

target_principal.description: GCP service account to impersonate. Required if authMethod is 'impersonation'.

project_id.description: DEPRECATED: Use authConfig.project_id instead. GCP project ID.

google_application_credentials.description: DEPRECATED: Use authConfig.service_account_json instead. JSON content of GCP credentials file. Can be omitted on GKE with workload identity.

azure.description: Azure Key Vault secrets store configuration. Only relevant if type is 'azure'. Uses Azure Service Connector authentication methods. See: https://docs.zenml.io/how-to/auth-management/azure-service-connector#authentication-methods

client_id.description: Azure service principal client ID. Required if authMethod is 'service-principal'.

client_secret.description: Azure service principal client secret. Required if authMethod is 'service-principal'.

tenant_id.description: Azure tenant ID. Required if authMethod is 'service-principal'.

key_vault_name.description: Name of the Azure Key Vault instance to use.

azure_client_id.description: DEPRECATED: Use authConfig.client_id instead. Azure service principal client ID.

azure_client_secret.description: DEPRECATED: Use authConfig.client_secret instead. Azure service principal client secret.

azure_tenant_id.description: DEPRECATED: Use authConfig.tenant_id instead. Azure tenant ID.

hashicorp.description: HashiCorp Vault secrets store configuration. Only relevant if type is 'hashicorp'.

vault_addr.description: URL of the HashiCorp Vault server.

vault_namespace.description: Vault Enterprise namespace. Not required for Vault OSS.

mount_point.description: The mount point to use. Defaults to 'secret' if not set.

auth_mount_point.description: Custom mount point to use for the authentication method.

app_role_id.description: Role ID for app_role authentication method. Required if authMethod is 'app_role'.

app_secret_id.description: Secret ID for app_role authentication method. Required if authMethod is 'app_role'.

aws_role.description: AWS role for the AWS authentication method. Relevant if authMethod is 'aws'.

aws_header_value.description: AWS header value for the AWS authentication method. Relevant if authMethod is 'aws' and the mount point enforces it.

vault_token.description: Token for token authentication method. Required if authMethod is 'token'.

max_versions.description: Maximum number of secret versions to keep. Defaults to 1 (only latest version).

custom.description: Custom secrets store configuration. Only relevant if type is 'custom'.

class_path.description: Full Python class path of the custom secrets store implementation. Must extend zenml.zen_stores.secrets_stores.base_secrets_store.BaseSecretsStore and be importable from the container image. Additional config options should be passed via zenml.environment / zenml.secretEnvironment using ZENML_SECRETS_STORE_<OPTION_NAME> naming convention.

backupSecretsStore.description: Backup secrets store settings. Used as a backup to the primary secrets store. Secret values for newly created and updated secrets are also saved here. Useful for high availability, disaster recovery, and migrating secrets between stores.

enabled.description: Set to true to enable a backup secrets store.

type.description: The type of backup secrets store to use. Additional configuration is required under the respective sub-sections depending on the type chosen.

sql.description: SQL backup secrets store configuration. Only relevant if type is 'sql'.

encryptionKey.description: Secret key used to encrypt secrets in the SQL database. Should be at least 32 random hex characters. Generate with: `openssl rand -hex 32`. If not set, encryption is disabled. IMPORTANT: keep this value safe; losing it means you cannot decrypt existing secrets.

aws.description: AWS backup secrets store configuration. Only relevant if type is 'aws'. Uses AWS Service Connector authentication. See: https://docs.zenml.io/how-to/auth-management/aws-service-connector#authentication-methods

region.description: AWS region where the Secrets Manager is located. Mandatory for all authentication methods.

aws_access_key_id.description: AWS access key ID. Required for secret-key, sts-token, iam-role, or federation-token auth methods.

aws_secret_access_key.description: AWS secret access key. Required for secret-key, sts-token, iam-role, or federation-token auth methods.

role_arn.description: AWS IAM role ARN. Required for iam-role auth method. Optional for implicit.

gcp.description: GCP backup secrets store configuration. Only relevant if type is 'gcp'. Uses GCP Service Connector authentication. See: https://docs.zenml.io/how-to/auth-management/gcp-service-connector#authentication-methods

project_id.description: GCP project ID where the Secrets Manager is located. Mandatory for all authentication methods.

user_account_json.description: GCP user account credentials JSON. Required if authMethod is 'user-account'.

service_account_json.description: GCP service account credentials JSON. Required if authMethod is 'service-account' or 'impersonation'.

target_principal.description: GCP service account to impersonate. Required if authMethod is 'impersonation'.

external_account_json.description: GCP workload identity credentials JSON. Required if authMethod is 'external-account'.

azure.description: Azure Key Vault backup secrets store configuration. Only relevant if type is 'azure'. Uses Azure Service Connector authentication. See: https://docs.zenml.io/how-to/auth-management/azure-service-connector#authentication-methods

client_id.description: Azure service principal client ID. Required if authMethod is 'service-principal'.

client_secret.description: Azure service principal client secret. Required if authMethod is 'service-principal'.

tenant_id.description: Azure tenant ID. Required if authMethod is 'service-principal'.

key_vault_name.description: Name of the Azure Key Vault instance to use.

hashicorp.description: HashiCorp Vault backup secrets store configuration. Only relevant if type is 'hashicorp'.

vault_addr.description: URL of the HashiCorp Vault server.

vault_namespace.description: Vault Enterprise namespace. Not required for Vault OSS.

mount_point.description: The mount point to use. Defaults to 'secret' if not set.

auth_mount_point.description: Custom mount point for the authentication method.

app_role_id.description: Role ID for app_role authentication. Required if authMethod is 'app_role'.

app_secret_id.description: Secret ID for app_role authentication. Required if authMethod is 'app_role'.

aws_role.description: AWS role for the AWS authentication method.

aws_header_value.description: AWS header value for the AWS authentication method.

vault_token.description: Token for token authentication. Required if authMethod is 'token'.

max_versions.description: Maximum number of secret versions to keep. Defaults to 1.

custom.description: Custom backup secrets store configuration. Only relevant if type is 'custom'.

class_path.description: Full Python class path of the custom secrets store implementation. Must extend BaseSecretsStore. Additional config via environment variables using ZENML_SECRETS_STORE_<OPTION_NAME> convention.

secure_headers.description: ZenML server secure headers configuration. Controls security headers in HTTP responses. Values: 'enabled'/'on'/'true'/'yes' = default value; 'disabled'/'off'/'false'/'none'/'no' = header not set; any other string = custom value.

server.description: The 'Server' HTTP header value used to identify the server. Default value is the ZenML server ID.

hsts.description: The 'Strict-Transport-Security' HTTP header value. Default: 'max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains'.

csp.description: The 'Content-Security-Policy' HTTP header value. Default is a strict CSP for the ZenML dashboard. NOTE: customizing this is discouraged as it may break the dashboard.

cache.description: The 'Cache-Control' HTTP header value. Default: 'no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate'.

permissions.description: The 'Permissions-Policy' HTTP header value. Default: 'accelerometer=(), camera=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()'.

environment.description: Extra environment variables to set in the ZenML server container as key-value pairs.

secretEnvironment.description: Extra environment variables to set in the ZenML server container that should be kept secret. These are stored as Kubernetes secrets and mounted as environment variables.

instanceLabel.description: Custom 'app.kubernetes.io/instance' label value. Used to uniquely identify the ZenML deployment in the cluster. All resources are labeled with this value. If not set, defaults to the Helm release name. Recommended to set to a unique identifier to avoid conflicts with other ZenML deployments.

service.description: Kubernetes service configuration for the ZenML server.

port.description: Port number for the ZenML server service.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the ZenML server service.

ingress.description: Ingress configuration for the ZenML server.

enabled.description: Whether to create an Ingress resource for the ZenML server.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the Ingress resource. Common annotations include nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect, nginx.ingress.kubernetes.io/rewrite-target, cert-manager.io/cluster-issuer, etc.

host.description: Hostname for the Ingress resource. Hint: you can use nip.io for wildcard DNS (e.g., zenml.192.168.0.1.nip.io).

path.description: URL path for the Ingress resource.

tls.description: TLS configuration for the Ingress resource.

enabled.description: Whether to enable TLS for the Ingress.

generateCerts.description: If enabled, self-signed certificates will be generated during installation. Requires the ingress host to be set to the domain name or IP used to access the ZenML server externally.

secretName.description: Name of the Kubernetes secret containing TLS certificates.

customCAs.description: Direct injection of CA certificates in PEM format.

name.description: Name identifier for the custom CA certificate.

secretRefs.description: References to existing Kubernetes secrets containing CA certificates.

name.description: Name of the Kubernetes secret containing the CA certificate.

key.description: Key within the secret that holds the CA certificate.

proxy.description: Proxy configuration for the ZenML server.

noProxy.description: Comma-separated list of hostnames/domains/IPs/CIDRs to exclude from proxying.

additionalNoProxy.description: Additional hostnames/domains/IPs/CIDRs to exclude from proxying.

create.description: Specifies whether a service account should be created.

annotations.description: Annotations to add to the service account.

name.description: The name of the service account to use. If not set and create is true, a name is generated using the fullname template.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the ZenML server pods.

podSecurityContext.description: Pod-level security context for the ZenML server pods. Set fsGroup if using a PVC for backup.

fsGroup.description: Group ID to use for the pod's filesystem. Should be set when using PVC for backup (e.g., 1000).

securityContext.description: Container-level security context for the ZenML server container.

runAsNonRoot.description: Indicates that the container must run as a non-root user.

runAsUser.description: The UID to run the container process as.

capabilities.description: Linux capabilities to add or drop.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits for the ZenML server container. It is recommended to leave this unset by default to increase compatibility with environments with limited resources (e.g., Minikube).

resourcesMigrationPod.description: Resource requests and limits for the database migration pod. If not set, falls back to the global resources configuration defined in resources.

limits.description: Resource limits for the migration pod.

requests.description: Resource requests for the migration pod.

autoscaling.description: Horizontal Pod Autoscaler (HPA) configuration for the ZenML server.

enabled.description: Whether to enable horizontal pod autoscaling.

minReplicas.description: Minimum number of replicas for autoscaling.

maxReplicas.description: Maximum number of replicas for autoscaling.

targetCPUUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average CPU utilization percentage for autoscaling.

targetMemoryUtilizationPercentage.description: Target average memory utilization percentage for autoscaling.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector constraints for scheduling ZenML server pods to specific nodes.

tolerations.description: Tolerations for scheduling ZenML server pods on tainted nodes.

value.description: Taint value to match (when operator is Equal).

tolerationSeconds.description: Period of time the toleration tolerates the taint (for NoExecute effect).

affinity.description: Affinity rules for scheduling ZenML server pods (nodeAffinity, podAffinity, podAntiAffinity).
